scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && concurrently "cross-env INPUT=index.html vite build" "cross-env INPUT=sandbox.html vite build"
scripts.watch: concurrently "cross-env INPUT=index.html vite build --watch" "cross-env INPUT=sandbox.html vite build --watch"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.dev:e2e: concurrently "npm --prefix ltft-server run dev" "npm --prefix gold-guide-server run dev" "sh -c 'until curl -s http://localhost:3001/mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -s http://localhost:3002/mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.5; done; npm run dev'"
